name: The Italian Sea Group S.p.A.
summary: The Italian Sea Group S.p.A. is a prominent player in the luxury yachting sector. The company's operations encompass the design, manufacturing, and marketing of high-end motor and sailing yachts, including superyachts. These vessels, crafted from fiberglass, aluminum, or steel, vary in size from 17 to over 100 meters and are sold under the distinguished Admiral, Tecnomar, Perini Navi, and Picchiotti brands. Additionally, the group offers specialized refit services for motor and sailing yachts through its NCA Refit brand. Established in 1942, this Italian firm is headquartered in Marina di Carrara and operates as a subsidiary of GC Holding S.P.A.
